description: The end control moves 4 along X. The three controls are collinear and the tangents all point along X, so the curve is the line from (0,0,0) to (12,0,0) at constant speed. The interior control rides the base curve at u = 0.5 to (6,0,0). The bind joints keep their rest parameters 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1, so they spread evenly: x = 0, 3, 6, 9, 12.
